title: DEI: The Myth of Merit and the Reality of Bias
deck: Didn’t Earn It? Or Did Equity Intervene?
byline: Originally published in Jam Sesh, my newsletter.
description: The case against DEI assumes hiring was merit-based to begin with. Decades of research says it never was. And the people shouting loudest about unqualified hires have made some interesting picks of their own.

disclosure.note: The argument, the words and the structure are mine. AI never drafted any of it; at most it proofread or helped track down a source. The illustration at the top is AI-generated.
